'''Hayden''' (Japanese: '''ハシバ''' ''Hashiba'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Fuchsia City]].

==In animation==
In {{aniseries|JN}}, Hayden is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN021|Caring for a Mystery!]]''.

Hayden met {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] while they were searching for a [[Pokémon Egg]]. Hayden challenged Ash to a Normal Class [[World Coronation Series]] {{pkmn|battle}}, which Ash accepted. Hayden sent out his {{p|Tauros}} to battle {{AP|Pikachu}} but was defeated, causing his rank to go down.

==Trivia==
* Hayden wears items that refer to his Pokémon; a headband with a drawing of {{p|Tauros}}'s horns and a vest with cords resembling the tails of a Tauros.
* Hayden's Japanese voice actor, [[Yasuhiro Mamiya]], was born in {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}}. {{wp|Tateyama, Chiba|Tateyama}}, the real-life counterpart of [[Fuchsia City]], is also located in Chiba.
